sharedEditsNeeded: To lift the region-expression subset: a size hook for the identity role (geometry or a per-link validation called by registry.ts validation and the three negotiators), so x/y/w/h can be evaluated per link as addroi_config_input does and only actual NaN results refused. Not made; the subset refusal is explicit instead.
notes: Role identity with no formats(), no frame and no geometry: native has no query_formats and is AVFILTER_FLAG_METADATA_ONLY. All five paths flagged; actor and timed differential tests pass.

NaN refusal: the identity role has no size hook, so parse proves NaN-freeness for every iw,ih in [1,2147483647] by interval bounds; addroiRegion reproduces config_input values for the unit tests but no path calls it.

qoffset follows opt.c exactly as probed: 1/-2 and -1/-2 fail the sscanf range check and are accepted as expressions; 0/0 and nan are EINVAL; 1/0 and 2 are ERANGE. Stored rationals checked against native av_d2q built from the sandbox libavutil.a.
Registry examples: addroi=0:0:iw/2:ih/2:-1/5, addroi=x=iw/4:w=iw*2:qoffset=1,hflip, addroi=clear=1,addroi=1:2:3:4:qoffset=0, format=nv12,addroi,vflip.
No float-sensitive cases, so no linux-gated tests; every test runs on every platform.
Mutations: dropping the qoffset range check failed 2 unit tests and the differential refusal test; dropping the zero-divisor check failed 1 unit test and the differential refusal test.
Environment: sandbox Node was v22.23.5; Node 24.22.3 installed from nodejs.org (sha256-checked) for bootstrap and tests.

Setup durations: Node 24 install ~10s; bootstrap (npm 8.0s, submodule 8.1s, reference build) 207.6s; baseline typecheck+lint+boundaries 55s, registry unit test 2s; final differential file 17.4s with --maxWorkers=1; final typecheck+lint+boundaries 54s.
